description: Acknowledgment message that contains the original message data for confirmation

original_message_type.description: Type of the original message being acknowledged

original_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the original message in microseconds since epoch

notes: This version includes the complete original message data for full confirmation
The original_message_data field contains the serialized msgpack of the original message
This allows the sender to verify exactly what was received and processed
Includes processing time tracking for performance monitoring
Extensible metadata field for additional ack information
